objective: One offline x86-64 QEMU image boots a minimal shell and emits timestamped HELLO every 120 seconds; exercise a hashed delegation and evidence receipt around the single implementation worker.

authority.allocation_status: pending Z assignment; cheap-GPT lanes are suggestions
authority.spend_gate: No new metered external API runs, paid services, or infrastructure until a numeric cap or existing-budget authorization is recorded by Z/Mark. Existing authorized subscription work may proceed with cost recorded as unavailable.
authority.first_build_method: Reuse pinned Buildroot, BusyBox, Linux kernel and compressed initramfs as the provisional existing proposal; record exact upstream versions/hashes. Stop for Z if another backend is needed.

worker_reads: This packet plus its exact-byte SHA-256 companion
Repository checkout at source_base_commit; inspect CONTRIBUTING.md and any applicable AGENTS.md
Only the allowed build/test paths and relevant upstream primary documentation
inputs.context_limit: Do not read the full repository or archive to reconstruct design. Read only named inputs and necessary build sources; ask Z for a targeted excerpt if a blocking fact is missing.
not_given: Full chat histories, prior model debates, or the 30 KB consolidated archive
Other agents' entire contexts or unrelated project documents
Workplace, client, medical, or union records
API credentials or an external-model budget
MCP/OpenRouter protocol as an offline boot requirement
inputs.source_summary: Consolidated P0 handoff read by Meraki in full; latest user direction controls. P0a is boot/heartbeat, P0b is correlated ACK, P0c is one laptop. Existing branch networked HELLO/ACK remains separate. No offline boot implementation found in inspected main/six branches; unavailable earlier specs must not be presumed nonexistent.

spec.runtime: RAM-first Linux kernel + compressed initramfs + static BusyBox + /init; no model or network dependency
spec.host: Linux build host; shell/Python test tooling allowed on host, not in runtime image
spec.boot: Direct kernel/initramfs QEMU boot is sufficient for P0a. EFI/USB/laptop boot is P0c, not claimed here.
spec.shell: Serial console accepts a shell command while heartbeat runs in background
spec.clock: Use guest monotonic uptime seconds; do not imply accurate wall-clock time without a clock source
spec.hello_sequence: First HELLO within 15 guest uptime seconds of /init, seq=1; subsequent records increment exactly once per 120-second interval
spec.size: Target about 20 MB; practical 40–60 MB. Hard P0 ceiling: kernel+compressed initramfs combined strictly below 100000000 bytes. Measure build output size separately from runtime RAM; do not call this combined payload a full bootable ISO.
spec.fedora: Retain a Fedora development connection where practical; do not add Fedora runtime packages solely for branding or change ABI assumptions.
spec.source_pinning: Record exact source versions, archive digests, config, toolchain/host versions and build command. Do not claim bit-for-bit reproducibility until separately tested.

acceptance: Clean pinned build exits zero and emits real kernel/initramfs artifacts plus manifest; never substitute a host script for a guest boot.
Host launcher starts QEMU with -nic none, no shared folders, no host block devices, controlled serial capture, and fixed memory. Record command and timeout.

Observed boot reaches a serial shell within 90 host monotonic seconds on the recorded host. Send a fresh host-generated token through a shell printf command and require the exact output line, not the echoed command text.

Observe three actual HELLO records with seq 1,2,3; require first guest uptime <=15 and successive guest uptime intervals 115–125 seconds. Host arrival intervals must be 105–150 seconds; hard total timeout 390 seconds. No shortened production interval merely to pass tests.
Run with 128 MiB guest RAM and record pass/fail. This establishes a tested allocation, not minimum RAM or resident usage; record those as unknown unless measured.
Combined kernel/initramfs size <100000000 bytes; report each artifact byte count and SHA-256.
Host checker rejects fixtures for missing heartbeat, duplicate sequence, malformed timestamp, incorrect interval, absent shell response, and timeout. Fixture passes are not evidence of real boot.
Review final runtime configuration for no guest networking and no GUI/Python/model runtime. Preserve config evidence; -nic none alone is not a containment proof.
Receipt includes packet hash, source base, result commit/patch, model identity evidence or uncertainty, attempts, reviewer outcome, usage/cost evidence or explicit nulls, and artifact hashes.
required_outputs: puppy-p0a/README.md with exact build and acceptance commands
puppy-p0a host acceptance checker and meaningful failure fixtures
Image artifacts retained with download location and hashes; no large binaries committed without a named storage decision
Preserved task branch/commit and draft PR; no merge
stopping_condition: Stop after acceptance evidence is complete and preserved for Z review. Mark alone gates merge. Stop and return a BLOCKED receipt on missing access/dependencies, exhausted approved budget, a required out-of-scope change, or two unsuccessful repair attempts after the first build failure. No silent architecture redesign or fallback to a hosted/networked demo.
explicit_non_goals: Nonce/request-bound ACK (P0b): a shell test token is not an ACK implementation
GUI, networking, SSH, package manager, Python or model runtime in guest
MCP, OpenRouter, external agents inside guest, orchestration service
SquashFS/OverlayFS modules, full Chamber containment, scrubber, recorder, security sign-off
Full MergeBot implementation, automatic merge, release or deployment
